feature.title: Revamp phase 2: one first-run flow, gesture trainer, MiniMax on first use, menu-bar finale
feature.problem: First run is two flows back to back. A four-slide tour explains features before anything works, then a six-step wizard sets them up, and the MiniMax step asks for a second API key that most people cannot use yet. The practice step shows three dots and a ring, so a failed gesture gets no reason. The Done screen is a table of settings and never says where Parley lives afterwards, and people forget the menu bar icon. On the dark Scene every light-variant Badge and Button (Missing, Grant …) renders solid black: Mantine's dark light-variant calls darken(), which cannot parse the theme's oklch colors and returns rgba(0,0,0,1). Phase 2 merges everything into one six-screen flow on the Scene: Welcome, Microphone, Accessibility, Transcription, Gesture trainer and First words, then a finale where the orb flies to the ◉ menu bar item. MiniMax leaves first run: the first voice edit or Explain gesture without a key opens a mode-colored offer instead of a toast. The tour stays, reachable only as a replay. Frame note: the settings window is not PageShell, so the archetypes below are illustrative and not probe-enforced, as in parley-007 and parley-008.
nonGoals: Native grouped-list settings, a status header or a time-saved stat — that is phase 3.
Validating a key on paste with no Save button — Test and save stays.
An orb that pulses to key presses in the real overlay — the trainer lights key caps only.
Animating across the real screen to the macOS menu bar — the flight stays inside the window, onto a drawn menu bar strip.
Migrating a stored mid-wizard step: indices keep their count (0–5, Done 6), so a resumed user may land one screen off, which is harmless.

surfaces.name: Welcome (screen 1 of 6)
surfaces.purpose: Replaces the tour on first run. One line of promise, the three modes each with its orb color, a privacy line and one button.

panels.title: Talk to any text field
panels.subtitle: Welcome to Parley
rows: ● amber   Voice edit — say how to change it
● cyan    Explain — ask about a selection
panels.footer: Mic is live only while you hold · about two minutes

states.loading: The Scene paints first and a Loader sits on it until settings resolve, as in phase 1.
states.empty: No empty state: the screen is static content.
states.error: Save failed on Get started: the red Alert shows above the column and the screen stays put.
states.success: Get started advances to Microphone and the ring sweeps on SPRING.

surfaces.name: Gesture trainer (screen 5 of 6)
surfaces.purpose: Replaces the Hotkeys step. One Kbd cap per press lights as you press, the last one fills while held, and a missed attempt says why in words from the real detector's constants. Capture sets the key, and the edit and explain keys plus the press count sit behind a More keys toggle.

panels.title: Learn the gesture
panels.subtitle: Right Option · Capture
rows: Too slow between taps — keep them within 0.3 s

states.loading: Settings resolve with the flow, so the caps draw with the stored key at once.
states.empty: Nothing pressed yet: every cap is unlit and the hint reads ‘Tap ⌥ twice, then hold it’.
states.error: A missed attempt resets the caps and names the reason: a tap held too long, too long a gap, or the hold let go early.
states.success: The hold completes: every cap turns teal and the live line reads ‘That’s the gesture ✓’. Continue is never gated on it.

surfaces.name: Finale (after screen 6)
surfaces.purpose: Replaces the Done table. The orb flies from the middle of the window onto a drawn menu bar strip next to ◉, and the copy says where Parley lives. Only missing items are listed, each with a fix.

panels.title: Parley lives in your menu bar
panels.subtitle: Wi‑Fi  ◉  9:41
rows: Hold ⌥ in any app to talk.

states.loading: Same Scene and Loader as the flow.
states.empty: Nothing missing: no rows, only the two lines of copy.
states.error: A missing permission or key shows as a row with Re-open step, which jumps back to that screen.
states.success: The orb lands on the strip after a beat, the Scene turns teal, and Start using Parley opens the tabbed settings. Under reduced motion the orb is already in place.

surfaces.name: MiniMax first-use offer (modal over any stage)
surfaces.purpose: The first voice edit or Explain gesture with no MiniMax key opens the settings window with this modal in place of a toast: what the two modes do, in their colors, and the key form.

panels.title: Voice edit and Explain need MiniMax
rows: ● amber  Voice edit rewrites the field
● cyan   Explain answers about a selection
[ MiniMax API key ••••• ] Test and save

states.loading: The key test shows the button's loading state.
states.empty: Opened with no key stored: the form is empty.
states.error: A key that fails its test shows the reason in red under the field, and the modal stays open.
states.success: The key stores, the modal says ‘Try the gesture again’ and closes itself.

overlays.title: Voice edit and Explain need MiniMax
overlays.trigger: session blocked with reason rewriteKey, pushed live or taken on mount

components.control: ColorSwatch per mode, colored from the --app-*-core tokens
components.why: It teaches the orb's three colors before the user ever sees the overlay, using a Mantine primitive rather than a hand-drawn dot.
components.rejected: The four-slide Carousel tour on first run (explains before anything works)

components.control: Kbd caps with a data-state (idle, lit, holding, done) styled by a CSS module, driven by a pure trainer reducer
components.why: The keys you press are the thing drawn, and the reducer mirrors gesture-detector's TAP_MAX_MS, GAP_MAX_MS and HOLD_MIN_MS, so a failure names a real reason.
components.rejected: Dots plus RingProgress (shows progress but never why a try failed)

components.control: Collapse behind a subtle ‘More keys’ Button holding GestureTab bare
components.why: Most people keep the default edit and explain keys, so progressive disclosure keeps the trainer the focus.
components.rejected: GestureTab always open under the trainer

components.control: motion layoutId shared between the centered orb and the menu bar strip slot
components.why: One spring flight with no measuring code, and MotionConfig reducedMotion=user already makes it instant.
components.rejected: Measured x/y keyframes (brittle at other widths)

components.why: Asking at the moment of need is a confirmation-shaped interruption, and the key form is already built.
components.rejected: A wizard step (asks before anyone needs it) or a toast (no way to act on it)

components.control: cssVariablesResolver dark overrides for --mantine-color-{brand,green,yellow,red}-light and -light-hover as color-mix of the filled shade
components.why: Fixes every light-variant Badge and Button app-wide at the root, not per call site.
components.rejected: Switching the PermissionRow badge and button to another variant (leaves the bug everywhere else)

endpoints.note: Returns and clears the reason a gesture was refused while the settings window was closed or loading, so the offer survives the window being created by the refusal itself. Settings window only.

integration.to: stageFor: wizard until onboarding completes, then the tour only if replayed
integration.note: complete() also sets tourSeen, so a new user never sees the tour unasked

integration.to: WelcomeStep, TranscriptionStep (renamed Groq), TrainerStep, FinaleStep; MinimaxStep and HotkeysStep removed
integration.note: Mic, Accessibility and First words keep their behaviour
live push unchanged when the window is loaded
rewriteKey no longer toasts; the other reasons still do

integration.to: replay only: last button reads Done, trust copy drops the setup line

verification: npm run ui-probe (Wizard stories: Welcome, Trainer, Finale; Tour stories)
Storybook screenshots at 760x560, dark and light: no black Badge or Button on the Scene
